text:
maria: Quick heads-up: NebulaRack signed off to pilot eu-west-3 but conditioned on marketplace listing + legal check. Need to align on capacity shape, SKU naming, networking, and a dry-run.

alex: Good news. What's initial capacity and any special networking requirements?

maria: Initial: 2 pods (pod = 4x A100) with option to scale to 4 pods after validation. Networking: private peering required, partner provides 10Gb NICs, limited public egress. Need to confirm egress caps for model pulls and telemetry.

li-chen: I'll own marketplace plan. Proposed SKUs: `redwood.dedicated.eu-west-3.p2` (2-pod hourly) and `redwood.dedicated.eu-west-3.p4` (4-pod reserved). Need partner test tenant and cert chain to validate provisioning flow and KMS passthrough.

maria: Partner contact: natalie@nebularack.com. Partner supports KMS passthrough via our gateway and HSM. I'll send NDA and request test creds + certs today.

sam: From legal: need VSA, DPA with EU residency clause, and ISO27001 attestation. They don't have SOC2; recommend alpha pool only and increased audit retention. Timeline: VSA + DPA draft required by Thu EOD to keep schedule.

alex: Draft dry-run plan: 1) Provision 2-pod via partner test tenant; 2) Perf smoke: 100 concurrent sessions for 10m, targets p50 <120ms p95 <450ms; 3) KV/prefix cache priming (hit rate >80%); 4) Failover 15% to eu-west-1 for 5m; 5) Metering sanity: pod-hour events to telemetry.

alex: Provision example (param):
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"sku":"redwood.dedicated.eu-west-3.p2","quantity":1,"config":{"kms":"passthrough","peering":"private"}}'

li-chen: I'll open the marketplace PR with mapping + add a CI smoke job to hit provision + perf checks. Will need partner creds and cert chain.

maria: Action items: maria -> NDA + partner test creds + cert chain (today); sam -> review VSA & DPA (Thu EOD); li-chen -> marketplace PR + CI smoke job (Fri); alex -> runbook + perf harness (Mon). Also need ops reviewer for peering config.

launch-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2024-07-09 09:00 UTC. Reminders: 48h and 1h prior.

maria: Great. After legal sign-off and PR merge we'll invite 2 alpha customers and run the dry-run. :thumbsup:
